payload.reason: The evidence provides specific methods for measuring topic quality, particularly through the use of NPMI scores to evaluate topic coherence.

claims.text: Topic quality is measured using the Normalised Pointwise Mutual Information (NPMI) score, which evaluates the semantic coherence of words in a topic.
Higher NPMI scores indicate better topic coherence, and the scores are averaged over multiple runs to assess topic quality.
MetaLDA outperforms other models in terms of NPMI scores, indicating it can discover more meaningful topics, thus improving topic quality.
